items.exampleEn: The police officer called for backup when the crowd grew larger.
items.exampleZh: 人群越聚越多時，那位警察呼叫支援。

items.exampleEn: Sunglasses act as a shield against strong light.
items.exampleZh: 太陽眼鏡就像一層擋住強光的防護。

items.exampleEn: She gave a gasp of surprise when she opened the gift.
items.exampleZh: 她打開禮物時驚訝得倒抽一口氣。

items.exampleEn: In the old story, the soldier refused to obey the king.
items.exampleZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，士兵拒絕服從國王。

items.exampleEn: The teacher told a joke to divert the children's attention from the storm.
items.exampleZh: 老師講了個笑話，轉移孩子們對暴風雨的注意力。

items.exampleEn: We lingered at the beach until the sun went down.
items.exampleZh: 我們在海邊流連到太陽下山。

items.exampleEn: Be careful not to stab yourself with the scissors.
items.exampleZh: 小心別被剪刀戳到自己。

items.exampleEn: He sniffed the milk to check if it was still fresh.
items.exampleZh: 他聞了聞牛奶，看看是否還新鮮。

items.sentenceEn: The smell of fresh bread lingered in the house all morning.
items.sentenceZh: 新鮮麵包的香味整個早上都留在屋子裡。

items.audioEn: Because of the parade, buses will be diverted along the river until six o'clock.
items.audioZh: 因為遊行，公車在六點以前會改道沿著河邊行駛。

items.sentenceEn: A gasp went through the crowd when the magician disappeared.
items.sentenceZh: 魔術師消失時，觀眾都倒抽了一口氣。

items.sentenceEn: My cat sniffs every new bag I bring home.
items.sentenceZh: 我的貓會去聞我帶回家的每一個新袋子。

items.stemEn: Children should learn to ____ the traffic rules when they cross the street.
items.stemZh: 孩子過馬路時應該學會遵守交通規則。

items.stemEn: Before you change the settings, make a ____ of all your photos.
items.stemZh: 更改設定之前，先把所有照片備份起來。

items.passageEn: My neighbor trains dogs to work with airport inspectors. Each dog learns to obey simple commands and to sniff bags for hidden fruit and meat. When a dog finds something, it sits down quietly instead of barking, so it doesn't divert other passengers' attention. Most dogs need a year of training, and each team has a backup dog in case one gets sick. My neighbor says the hardest part is keeping the dogs calm in a noisy hall.
items.passageZh: 我的鄰居訓練狗和機場檢查人員一起工作。每隻狗都要學會服從簡單的指令，並嗅出行李裡藏著的水果和肉類。狗找到東西時，會安靜地坐下而不是吠叫，這樣才不會轉移其他旅客的注意力。大多數的狗需要一年的訓練，而且每個小組都有一隻備用的狗，以防有狗生病。我的鄰居說，最難的是讓狗在吵雜的大廳裡保持冷靜。

questions.questionZh: 狗找到東西時會怎麼做？
每個小組為什麼有一隻備用的狗？

items.promptZh: 他用叉子戳了一塊蛋糕。
referenceEn: He stabbed a piece of cake with his fork.
He used his fork to stab a piece of cake.
rubricZh: 要用 stab（例如 stabbed a piece of cake）
「用叉子」可寫，例如 with his fork、used his fork to 等
時態配合內容（例如 stabbed、stabs 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 shield 當名詞造一個句子，說說某樣東西怎麼保護你。
referenceEn: A thick coat is a good shield against the cold wind.
My umbrella was my only shield against the heavy rain.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 shield 當名詞（例如 a shield against…）
說明它擋住什麼（例如 the cold wind、the heavy rain 等）
